{{Quote|When placed on the surface of a planet, the Shock Drum emitted concentric ultrasonic waves. Over the course of hours or days, these waves grew in strength until they shook continents. Though never tested, a Shock Drum left unattended would in theory tear a planet apart.|Bevel Lemelisk|<ref name="swih">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
The '''Shock Drum''' was a [[Superweapon/Legends|Superweapon]] created by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

A large ovoid device the size of a cavern, when activated it generated intense ultrasonic vibrations that disabled [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and other technology in an ever widening circle with the Shock Drum at its epicenter. The Shock Drum's vibrations became increasingly powerful the longer it was left on and in time resulted in massive seismic [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] and damage and even death to organic life within range as their molecules literally vibrated apart.

It was originally conceived of as a device for deployment against enemy fortifications and military bases where it would soften them up by disabling and weakening their defenses. However it was discovered by Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] that over a prolonged period it would cause the core of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to destabilize eventually causing it to reach critical mass and literally shatter apart, destroying the entire planet. Following this discovery the head of the Republic's superweapons program, General [[Var Suthra]] shut the project down and they only ever produced a single prototype based on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

Unfortunately for the Republic, the details of the Shock Drum were among those plans stolen by [[Sith Order|Sith]] infiltrator [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]]. This resulted in the Sith, under the command of [[Darth Angral]] seizing control of the project and stealing the prototype. On learning that the [[Hero of Tython|Jedi]] responsible for his son's death was on Tatooine, [[Darth Angral]] ordered his subordinate Lord [[Praven]] to activate the Shock Drum and destroy Tatooine in order to kill the Jedi and his companions. However, Praven disobeyed his master's order to destroy the new deactivation code, believing he should face the Jedi Knight honorably. Fortunately, after defeating [[Praven]] in a duel the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] surrendered to him and was convinced to join the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. With his help the Jedi Knight was able to shut down the Shock Drum before it destabilized the planet's core.

==Behind the scenes==
Depending on the player's choices, the Shock Drum can either be buried, leave its fate up to [[Var Suthra]] or agree to its continued use.

''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' mentions the Shock Drum in its section on superweapons, but mistakenly states that it was built by the Sith Empire.
